adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces server-side fetching of arbitrary URLs via `open(url)` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb`), called from `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (`lib/topic_retriever.rb`). `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` only checks `URI(@embed_url).host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host` and does not constrain scheme, block redirects, or pin/verify resolved IPs. Because `open-uri` will follow HTTP redirects and DNS for an allowed hostname can be rebound/repointed, a URL that passes the host string check can still result in requests to other/internal addresses (SSRF). This is a real security exposure grounded in the added code paths.
